rules.comment: Organic Maps builds the same navigation notification as its CoMaps fork (verified in OM NavigationService.java: title = distToTurn, text = nextStreet, turn arrow = setLargeIcon(Bitmap) only). So maneuver is UNKNOWN on purpose — the watch shows distance + road with a neutral marker, not a fabricated arrow. Locale-agnostic: only the numeric distance is matched. Authored from the OM source; validate against a real Organic Maps capture. See rules/bundled/comaps/any.json.
